decisions.basis: Dossier 0053:r2:i5 S2 predicate, fcstm_model:S2 receipt verdict false.

decisions.violated_obligation: A transition from PumpControl to MethaneState exists.

decisions.basis: Dossier 0053:r2:i6 S2 predicate, fcstm_model:S2 receipt verdict false, inspection reachability.
decisions.reason: NL3 requires first transition to PumpState. PumpControl initial transition goes to UnspecifiedInitial via transition:line:16; PumpState reachable only via PumpRegion initial. Verify facts refute reachability of PumpState from initial. S2 owner-local initial entry check is false.
decisions.violated_obligation: PumpControl must initially enter PumpState as its first substate entry.

decisions.basis: Dossier 0053:r2:i7 S2 predicate, fcstm_model:S2 receipt verdict false.

decisions.violated_obligation: A transition endpoint from PumpControl to WaterState must exist.

decisions.basis: Dossier 0053:r2:i8 S2 predicate, fcstm_model:S2 receipt verdict false.
decisions.reason: NL5 requires PumpControl to MethaneState. No direct edge exists; MethaneState is entered via MethaneRegion initial. S2 check is false.
decisions.violated_obligation: A transition endpoint from PumpControl to MethaneState must exist.

decisions.basis: Dossier 0053:r2:i9 candidate, closed model action facts, NL3 requirement.
decisions.reason: NL3 requires PumpState where pump is activated or controlled. Closed model state PumpState has no action_fact; state name carries PlantUML body text but no executable action is registered. Author-intent text is not a formal action_fact, so the state_action requirement is not satisfied.
decisions.violated_obligation: PumpState must exhibit pump activation or control behavior.

result.reason: All nineteen obligations were assessed from the supplied NL contracts, exact source inventory, closed FCSTM model facts, and deterministic receipts. Containment, initial-entry, transition-endpoint, reachability and V1 deadlock obligations show a first violated-obligation reading supported by exact model facts or false backend verdicts; containment obligations remain violations under the exact direct-containment contract with indirect reachability being a weaker non-rebutting property. Action obligations lack action_fact in the closed model. Reachability obligations are false per G1 topology checks. V1 leaf UnspecifiedInitial is reachable with no outgoing continuation and no formal terminal evidence. The System-start initial-entry obligation cannot be decided due to missing exact binding and unsupported predicate. No competent undercutting or rebutting defeater survives under the supplied dossier.
